h1: Custom Tri Blend Jackets for Corporate Apparel
metaTitle: Custom Tri Blend Jackets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom tri blend jackets for your team. Soft, durable, and comfortable for logos. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Tri blend fabric combines polyester, cotton, and rayon for a soft, lived-in feel that resists pilling and shrinking. These custom tri blend jackets work well for corporate giveaways, team uniforms, or employee rewards because the material holds vibrant embroidery and screen printing without stiffness. Choose a tri blend jacket when you want a lightweight layer that feels broken in from day one and keeps its shape wash after wash.
heroAltText: Custom tri blend jackets with embroidered logos, soft fabric blend for corporate apparel
